name: pi-clik
description: Inline suggestion snippets for pi: a web UI where the model's suggested replies render as clickable chips

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild src/extension/pi-clik.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/extension/pi-clik.js && esbuild src/extension/pi-clik-tui.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/extension/pi-clik-tui.js
scripts.test: vitest run test/parser.test.ts test/render.test.ts test/composer.test.ts test/app.test.ts test/tui.test.ts
